facts.text: Tanque Verde means "green tank," a name that references algae in a large stock water tank that stood in the area during the late 19th century.
In 1989, the town became the main filming location for Nickelodeon’s show Hey Dude, giving it a spot in television history.
After Fort Lowell closed in 1891, soldiers’ abandoned adobe buildings attracted Hispanic ranchers who settled and built the community that would become Tanque Verde.
The Tanque Verde Valley is framed by the Santa Catalina Mountains to the north and the Rincon Mountains to the east, creating its distinctive landscape.
Pantano Wash feeds into Tanque Verde Creek, which joins to form the Rillito River, a vital waterway that supports local farming.
By the 1960s, Tanque Verde had transformed into a true suburb of Tucson, reflecting its suburban growth.
